title: DDR3 frontend-to-backend bundle manifest
description: Contract for a bundle handed from the RTL-generation subsystem to the backend. One manifest describes one synthesizable unit: either a leaf block or the structural top level. Cross-bundle rules that JSON Schema cannot express (source resolution, width agreement, single-top) are enforced by schema/validate_bundles.py.

module_name.description: Top module defined by this bundle. Must be declared in exactly one of the files listed in `file`.

file.description: RTL source(s), relative to the bundle directory. A string for a single-file block; an array for a bundle whose module spans several sources, such as the top level. Array order is passed through to VERILOG_FILES unchanged.

kind.description: block = a leaf module. top = the structural module that instantiates the blocks. Exactly one bundle in a set may be `top`.

ports.description: Port list grouped by function. Group names are free-form and carry no semantics except `clock_reset`, which the packager reads to infer the clock and reset.

clock_reset.description: Clock and reset ports. Entries here must not carry `source` — clock and reset are distributed by the top level, not wired as data edges.

parameters.description: Elaboration parameters. May be empty. Values are informational for the backend; the RTL's own defaults are authoritative.

dependencies.description: Blocks this one consumes signals from. Must be consistent with the `source` fields on this bundle's input ports.

phase.description: Generation phase. 1 = root block fed from outside the controller; higher phases consume earlier ones. Used to order bring-up, not to drive the flow.

agent.description: Frontend agent that produced this bundle. Provenance only.

assertions.description: Properties the validation subsystem is expected to prove. Carried through by the backend, never interpreted by it — kept permissive on purpose so the validation team can extend the entry shape without breaking intake.

coverage_points.description: Coverage bins for the validation subsystem. Opaque to the backend.

platform.description: Target PDK. Omit to let the backend's PLATFORM default apply.

clock_port.description: Explicit clock port name. Overrides inference from ports.clock_reset.

clock_period_ns.description: Target clock period. Omitted values default to 10.0 ns and raise packager warning OR-003.

orfs_config.description: ORFS make variables this design needs, appended verbatim to config.mk (e.g. {"SYNTH_ARGS": "-nofsm"}). Use only for settings the design genuinely requires; the backend owns floorplan and timing defaults.

width.description: Total bits. An integer, a decimal string, or "NxM" for an unpacked array of N entries by M bits.

source.description: For an input only: the driving port, as `<module_name>.<port_name>`. This is the connectivity contract the top-level elaborator reads. An input with no `source` is promoted to a top-level chip pin, so omitting one that should be wired silently changes the design.

then.description: Only inputs may declare a source.
